summary: - **[key4hep/EDM4hep#528](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/528)** — Adds a `timeError` member to `TrackerHit3D`, `TrackerHitPlane`, `SenseWireHit` and the `TrackerHit` interface, mirroring the existing `eDep`/`eDepError` pair. This is a schema change: the schema version is bumped and the previous schema is preserved as `old_schemas/edm4hep_v6.yaml` for schema evolution.

- **[key4hep/k4GaudiPandora#55](https://github.com/key4hep/k4GaudiPandora/pull/55)** — Calorimeter hit conversion for Pandora now goes through the Pandora machinery using the newly introduced `LCCaloHit`s, which allow more flexible customisation. It depends on LCContent#45, and its output was validated as unchanged.

- **[key4hep/k4PFHitML#5](https://github.com/key4hep/k4PFHitML/pull/5)** — Aligns HitPF output definitions with Pandora by adding HitPF cluster outputs and updating the `referencePoint` definition. Downstream consumers comparing HitPF and Pandora outputs should expect changed content.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#71](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/71)** — Adds BIBUtils, Gaudi-native ports of the Muon Collider beam-induced-background cleaning algorithms, with a README, example steering files and tests. The new algorithms are `TrackerHitHelixFilter`, `SplitCollectionByPolarAngle`, `SplitCollectionByLayer`, `CaloHitConeFilter` and `CaloHitSelector`. This completes the upstreaming from the k4reco fork, and k4Reco now requires the ROOT Hist component.

- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#403](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/403)** — Adds an option to run conformal tracking with silicon hits in the full ALLEGRO digitisation and reconstruction sequence, enabled for ALLEGRO_o1_v03 and ALLEGRO_o2_v01. It relies on k4Reco#72 to keep tracks without an ECAL intersection, and on cylindrical calorimeter surface plugins for proper extrapolation.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1699](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1699)** — Adds a `symmetry=0` option so the calorimeter barrel and endcap face-surface plugins can produce cylindrical surfaces instead of only polyhedra. This enables proper track extrapolation to cylindrical calorimeters such as ALLEGRO's ECAL.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#66](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/66)** — Fixes `EDMToHepMCConverter`, which set the particle energy to the mass and divided the vertex time by c instead of multiplying. Fixes `FlatSmearVertex`, which used dz/c instead of dz as the time offset for events shifted along the beam. Both bugs corrupted the kinematics and timing of converted or smeared events.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1691](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1691)** — `HepMC3EventReader` now applies the HepMC3 length unit to the primary vertex x/y/z coordinates. Previously, input files using centimetres produced incorrect vertex positions in simulation.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1690](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1690)** — DDG4 sensitive detectors now keep track-state changes, such as volume exits, when a step is removed by an energy filter. Previously such hits stayed open into the next sensor, producing averaged hit positions outside the sensors, including spurious stripes at z=0 (k4geo#538).

- **[key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper#490](https://github.com/key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper/pull/490)** — Fixes per-event refresh of Marlin random seeds. The old new-event detection compared `LCEvent` pointers, and since new events were frequently allocated at the same address, processors reused identical seeds across events. A regression test covers the fix.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#112](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/112)** — The GenFit track fitter now resets the global TGeoManager navigator to a canonical state before each fit and restores it afterwards. Without this, materials assigned at geometry boundaries could depend on previously fitted tracks, making results depend on processing order. `isPositiveSemiDefinite` is removed from the utilities.

- **[hep-fcc/k4RecCalorimeter#290](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/290)** — Removes O(N_hits × N_particles) scans in `CreateTruthLinks` by iterating only over map entries and using a cellID index for links. This substantially speeds up truth linking, and an element-by-element comparison confirmed the output links and their order are unchanged.
